scheme_name: Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY: Medical Treatment - Gujarat
description:
The Group Accident Insurance Scheme under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) is a significant initiative launched by the Government of India to provide financial security to individuals engaged in the fisheries sector. 

The scheme was launched in 2020 as a part of the PMMSY, which aims to enhance the fish production and productivity in the country. 

The PMMSY was officially launched on 20th September 2020 by the Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi. 

The primary objective of the Group Accident Insurance Scheme is to provide insurance coverage to fishers and fish farmers against accidental death and disability. 

The scheme aims to cover approximately 1.5 million beneficiaries across the country. 

The insurance coverage under this scheme is set at ₹2 lakh for accidental death. 

In case of permanent total disability, the beneficiaries are entitled to the same amount of ₹2 lakh. 

For permanent partial disability, the compensation amount is ₹1 lakh. 

The scheme is particularly beneficial for the economically weaker sections of society who rely on fishing as their primary source of income. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme include individuals who are actively engaged in fishing or aquaculture. 

Beneficiaries must be aged between 18 and 70 years to qualify for the insurance coverage. 

The income limit for eligibility is set at ₹2 lakh per annum for individuals. 

The scheme also targets women and marginalized communities to ensure inclusivity. 

To apply for the Group Accident Insurance Scheme, interested individuals must follow a specific application process. 

The first step is to obtain the application form from the local fisheries department office or the official PMMSY website. 

Applicants must fill out the form with accurate details and submit it along with required documents. 

The required documents include proof of identity such as Aadhaar card, proof of income, and a certificate of engagement in fishing or aquaculture. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be verified by the local fisheries department officials. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 to 30 days. 

Upon successful verification, beneficiaries will receive their insurance policy documents. 

The insurance coverage is active for one year from the date of issue. 

The premium for the insurance policy is subsidized by the government. 

The government covers 100% of the premium cost for the beneficiaries under this scheme. 

This ensures that the insurance is accessible to all eligible individuals without any financial burden. 

The disbursement of claims is facilitated through the local fisheries department. 

In the event of an accident leading to death or disability, the beneficiaries or their families can file a claim. 

The claim process requires submission of the claim form along with necessary documents such as death certificate or medical reports. 

The claims are typically processed within 30 days of submission. 

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Department of Fisheries under the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying. 

The contact details for the Department of Fisheries can be found on the official government website. 

The scheme is part of a larger effort to improve the socio-economic conditions of fishers and fish farmers in India. 

The PMMSY aims to increase fish production from 137 lakh metric tonnes in 2019-20 to 200 lakh metric tonnes by 2024-25. 

This ambitious target reflects a growth rate of approximately 46% over five years. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a crucial component of this larger vision. 

By providing financial security, the scheme encourages more individuals to engage in sustainable fishing practices. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the vulnerability of fishers to accidents and unforeseen circumstances. 

The government has allocated a significant budget for the implementation of the PMMSY, amounting to ₹20,050 crores. 

This budget includes provisions for various welfare schemes including the Group Accident Insurance Scheme. 

The scheme is expected to enhance the overall productivity and sustainability of the fisheries sector. 

The government also emphasizes the importance of awareness programs to educate fishers about the benefits of the scheme. 

Workshops and training sessions are organized by the local fisheries department to disseminate information. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a step towards ensuring the welfare of fishers in Gujarat and across India. 

The scheme aligns with the government's commitment to uplift the livelihoods of those dependent on fisheries. 

The insurance coverage provided under this scheme is a vital safety net for families in case of tragic accidents. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also instills a sense of security among fishers. 

The government continuously monitors the implementation of the scheme to ensure its effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a testament to the government's efforts to promote social security in the fisheries sector. 

By addressing the risks associated with fishing, the scheme contributes to the overall development of the community. 

The initiative is expected to foster a more resilient and sustainable fisheries sector in Gujarat. 

With the support of the government, fishers can focus on improving their livelihoods without the constant worry of financial instability due to accidents. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme under PMMSY is a crucial welfare initiative that underscores the importance of social security for marginalized communities in India. 

The scheme is a significant step towards achieving the broader goals of economic development and poverty alleviation in the fisheries sector. 

Overall, the Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a well-structured initiative that provides essential support to fishers and their families. 

This scheme is a vital part of the government's strategy to enhance the welfare of individuals engaged in the fisheries sector. 

The comprehensive coverage and support offered through this scheme demonstrate the government's commitment to the well-being of its citizens. 

The Group Accident Insurance Scheme is a model for similar initiatives aimed at providing social security to vulnerable populations across various sectors in India.
